subject: sociology
title: Marxism Applied
welcome_lead: Apply Marx and Althusser to schools, media and law. Spot capitalism's hidden machinery in everyday life.
meta_desc: GCSE Sociology adventure applying Marx and Althusser to ISAs, false consciousness and modern Marxism.
final_note: Always name a Marxist study when claiming an institution serves capitalism.

walkthroughs.body_html: Althusser said the state has two arms. The Repressive State Apparatus (police, army, courts) uses force. The Ideological State Apparatus (school, media, religion, family) shapes ideas. Together they keep the system going.
Bowles and Gintis applied Marxism to school. Their correspondence principle says school life mirrors factory life, training working-class pupils to obey and accept inequality as natural.
Marxist media theorists like Curran and Seaton show how owners shape news to defend capitalism. The Glasgow Media Group showed strikes are reported as workers' fault, not management's.
